meta.notes: Typical magnitudes for 10-K captions by industry. basis is pct_of_revenue, pct_of_assets, or share_of_inventory; p25/p50/p75 are cross-sectional. Income-statement captions must be scaled so that gross and operating margins land inside fin.<industry>.* benchmarks; balance-sheet captions must be rescaled to sum to 100% of assets on each side (they are typical magnitudes, not a closed system).
